steps.instruction: In a 3-quart bowl, beat 1 cup of sugar into 5 egg yolks with a whisk.
steps.spoken: In a 3-quart bowl, beat 1 cup of sugar into 5 egg yolks with a wire whisk, until the mixture is pale yellow and forms a ribbon.

steps.instruction: Bring 2 cups of milk to a boil.
While whisking, pour the hot milk onto the egg mixture in a thin stream.
steps.spoken: Keep beating while you pour the hot milk onto the egg yolk mixture in a thin stream.

steps.instruction: Pour the mixture into a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Bring to a boil slowly, stirring well to avoid lumps.
When it boils, keep stirring for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: When it reaches a boil, stir for 2 to 3 minutes to cook the flour well. Be careful not to burn it on the bottom of the pan.

steps.instruction: Take the pan off the heat.
Beat in 1 1/2 tablespoons of vanilla extract.
Cover the surface with a sheet of parchment paper.
steps.spoken: Cover the surface with a sheet of parchment paper to keep a skin from forming, and let it cool. Makes 1 pint.
